comportamentos: Register extra fonts in the PDF helper (DejaVu Sans/Serif/Mono and Noto Sans Math) so Unicode symbols such as sigma render: missing
Extend Prawn fallback_fonts so glyphs missing from FreeSans fall back to fonts with wider Unicode coverage: missing
Allow Unicode (e.g. sigma) in the thesis title to be stored in MySQL: present (the candidate adds a utf8mb4 migration for enrollments.thesis_title; the official fix makes no column change)
